# ISU Student Community

> ISU is a student community run entirely by students: help with paperwork, housing and studies, events every week, and groups for every part of student life. Website made by Sherin Varghese (https://sherin.fun).

- [Home](https://isu.sherin.fun/)
- [Community and groups](https://isu.sherin.fun/community)
